notes: CompanyToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Company.md (COMD) with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the deploying factory. It has no administrative roles, transfer fees, external mint or burn functions, or application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token's total supply.
